1739-4659-5224-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1} due to Herald's Horn, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-5470-8227-8296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-5470-8227-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

401-1531-2530-3944.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-1531-2530-3944.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Deathgreeter trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

4477-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4477-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
4477-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Greenwarden of Murasa and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

394-586-864-3125-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-586-864-3125-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Desecrated Tomb.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2445-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1621-3375-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

413-1263-4871-6112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Fumulus and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

277-573-774.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tiller Engine each trigger.
Resolve Tiller Engine's ability, untapping Gruul Turf.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Gruul Turf's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
277-573-774.notes: After gaining an arbitrarily large amount of mana, you may repeat the loop choosing Tiller Engine's other mode to tap any number of nonland permanents opponents control.

2511-3497-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
2511-3497-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

4038-4747-5963.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 2 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
4038-4747-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Alena's ability by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3303-6196.description: Whenever a player casts a nonlegendary creature spell, Bazaar of Wonders' second ability triggers, countering that spell, as the creature with Spy Kit attached will share a name with that spell.

2034-2919-3490-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-4506.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1778-2292-4053-6989.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1671-5478-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-5478-5702-6850.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

460-539-4667.description:
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1274-3641-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3641-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-2525-4681.description:
Cast Body Double by paying {4}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station triggers, with the Body Double trigger targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Body Double.
Resolve the Body Double trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, with the Karmic Guide trigger targeting Body Double.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
Repeat from step 2.

851-2457-5794-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

478-804-2821-3488-3573.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-3488-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
478-804-2821-3488-3573.description:
Animate Candelabra using Katsumasa
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Tolarian Academy.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

2061-3277-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
2061-3277-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3259-5404--7.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
3259-5404--7.description:
Declare the legendary creature with haste and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Shaun's first ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token of the legendary creature with haste that isn't legendary.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the token copy of the legendary creature with haste, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2763-4049-4836.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least three loyalty counters on it.
2763-4049-4836.description:
Activate Kaya's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, exiling Hesitation and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Spirit in addition to its other types.
Whenever a player casts a spell, the Hesitation token triggers, countering that spell and causing you to fail to sacrifice it due to The Master.
Repeat step 2 as necessary.

435-1355-3953-5275.notablePrerequisites:
Triclopean Sight attached to Sanctum Weaver.
Sanctum Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three enchantments.
435-1355-3953-5275.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Auratog by sacrificing Triclopean Sight.
Mazzy's second ability triggers, exiling Triclopean Sight from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Auratog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Cast Triclopean Sight from exile by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Sanctum Weaver.
Triclopean Sight enters the battlefield, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

512-2067-3499-4289.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures you control is at least fifteen.
512-2067-3499-4289.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat step 2 until you have at least fifteen tapped creatures.
Activate Halo Fountain's third ability by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}, tapping it and untapping fifteen tapped creatures you control, causing you to win the game.

586-2170-2232-2932.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Kalastria Healer from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Priest of Gix ability, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Kalastria Healer by paying {B}.
Kalastria Healer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Kalastria Healer's ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

757-2402-4353.notablePrerequisites:
Magosi, the Waterveil has at least two eon counters on it.
Magosi is untapped.
757-2402-4353.description:
Activate Nesting Grounds's last ability by paying {1} and tapping it, moving an eon counter from Magosi to Nesting Grounds.
Activate Magosi's last ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your end step, Atraxa triggers, causing you to proliferate, putting an additional eon counter on Nesting Grounds.
On your next extra turn, activate Nesting Grounds's last ability by paying {1} and tapping it, moving an eon counter from Nesting Grounds to Magosi.
Repeat from step 2.
